_comment: UiPath Test Cloud integration config for Mopot. Import in UiPath Test Cloud > Projects > New Project.

project.name: Mopot Flutter Tests
project.description: Automated test suite for the target Flutter Android application

output._note: tester_agent.py converts flutter JSON output to JUnit XML via convert_flutter_json_to_junit_xml()

_setup_instructions: 1. In UiPath Test Cloud, create a new project and import this config
2. Set FLUTTER_PROJECT_PATH to the absolute path of your Flutter project
3. Set MOPOT_AVD to your Android Virtual Device name (e.g. Pixel_9_Pro)
4. Connect your UiPath Robot so it can execute flutter test commands
5. The tester_agent.py calls run_tests() which outputs results to the configured path
